The OpenAPI description of this version has 131 operations. For each route, the list names its purpose, its parameters (a parameter or body field marked with \* is required), the least role in multi-user mode, and whether it needs a token in single-user mode.

### Sign-in and session

Tokens, the session of the caller, and tickets for WebSocket connections.

`POST /api/v1/login`
: Sign in with user name and password from the user file and receive a bearer token.

  Body: `username`\*, `password`\*. Open without sign-in.

`POST /api/v1/logout`
: Revoke the bearer token of the caller.

  Open without sign-in.

`GET /api/v1/auth/session`
: Return the security mode, role, and user of the caller, and whether a local token is available.

  Open without sign-in.

`POST /api/v1/ws-ticket`
: Issue a short-lived one-time ticket for a WebSocket connection (`?ticket=` on the handshake).

  Role: user.

### Corpora and import

The corpus catalog, the capabilities of each corpus, and import jobs.

`GET /api/v1/corpora`
: List the corpora of the catalog with token and document counts and capability flags.

  Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/import-methods`
: List the import methods and whether each one is available in this installation.

  Role: admin.

`POST /api/v1/corpora/import-preflight`
: Check an import input (path, format, columns, free disk space) without starting a job.

  Body: `method`\*, `input_path`\*, `target_name`, and the options that `GET /api/v1/corpora/import-methods` lists for the method. Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/imports`
: List the import jobs of this server process.

  Role: admin.

`POST /api/v1/corpora/imports`
: Start an import job from a file or folder that the server can read.

  Body: `method`\*, `input_path`\*, `target_name`, `activate_on_success`, and the options that `GET /api/v1/corpora/import-methods` lists for the method. Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/imports/{job_id}`
: Return the state and progress of one import job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*. Role: admin.

`POST /api/v1/corpora/imports/{job_id}/cancel`
: Cancel a queued or running import job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*. Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/imports/{job_id}/reports`
: Return the build report, the rejected rows report, and the manifest of one import job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*. Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/{corpus}/build-report`
: Return the build report of a corpus in the catalog.

  Parameters: `corpus`\*. Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/corpora/{corpus}/capabilities`
: Return what a corpus supports, from its manifest and its files.

  Parameters: `corpus`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/corpora/register`
: Add an existing index directory to the catalog without copying or changing it.

  Body: `path`\*, `activate`, `acknowledge_partial_input`. Role: admin.

`POST /api/v1/corpora/{corpus}/activate`
: Make a corpus the active corpus of the catalog.

  Parameters: `corpus`\*. Body: `acknowledge_partial_input`, the body is optional. Role: user.

`DELETE /api/v1/corpora/{corpus}/registration`
: Remove a corpus from the catalog and keep its files.

  Parameters: `corpus`\*. Role: admin.

`DELETE /api/v1/corpora/{corpus}`
: Remove a corpus from the catalog (admin role). The active corpus and the last corpus are refused with 409.

  Parameters: `corpus`\*. Role: admin.

### Search and concordance

Concordance lines, streamed results, exact hit counts, and query checks.

`GET /api/v1/query`
: Return one page of concordance lines for a plain search or a query with the `cql:` prefix.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `ctx`, `corpus`, `date`, `genre`, `limit`, `offset`, `sort_by`, `sort_dir`, `sample`, `seed`, `user`, `case_insensitive`, `caseInsensitive`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/query/stream`
: Stream concordance lines as server-sent events (`count`, `batch`, `progress`, `done`) in corpus order.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `ctx`, `corpus`, `date`, `genre`, `docset_id`, `batch_size`, `limit`, `offset`, `sort_by`, `sort_dir`, `sample`, `seed`, `user`, `case_insensitive`, `caseInsensitive`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/query/analyse`
: Check a query and return errors, suggested corrections, and hints without running it.

  Body: `query`\*, `corpus`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/query/lexicon/suggest`
: Return values of an attribute (word, lemma, part of speech) that start with a prefix.

  Body: `attr`\*, `prefix`, `limit`, `corpus`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/query/count`
: Return the exact hit count of a query. The first answer can be `running`, `wait_ms` waits for the result.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `ctx`, `corpus`, `date`, `genre`, `docset_id`, `start`, `wait_ms`, `user`, `case_insensitive`, `caseInsensitive`. Role: user.

### Documents

The document list, the full text of one document, and a snippet around a position.

`GET /api/v1/docs/search`
: Return documents ranked by a search term.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `top_n`, `snippet`, `metric`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/doc/snippet`
: Return a longer passage around a token position, within its document.

  Parameters: `pos`\*, `ctx`, `corpus`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/document/{doc_id}`
: Return the full text of one document by internal number or by the document ID of the import.

  Parameters: `doc_id`\*, `corpus`, `by`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/docs/list`
: Return one page of the documents of a corpus or document set with a preview, and the metadata fields of the corpus that name documents and tell them apart.

  Parameters: `corpus`, `offset`, `limit`, `docset_id`, `scope_docset_id`. Role: user.

### Metadata, document sets, and subcorpora

Metadata fields and values, document sets built from metadata or from a search, and saved subcorpora.

`GET /api/v1/subcorpora`
: List the saved subcorpora.

  Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/subcorpora`
: Save a named subcorpus from a filter definition, or replace one.

  Body: `name`, `corpus`, `filter_spec`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/subcorpora/{name}`
: Return one saved subcorpus.

  Parameters: `name`\*. Role: user.

`DELETE /api/v1/subcorpora/{name}`
: Delete one saved subcorpus.

  Parameters: `name`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/subcorpora/{name}/resolve`
: Turn a saved subcorpus into a fresh document set. `stale` is true when the metadata schema changed since it was saved.

  Parameters: `name`\*. Body: `corpus`, the body is optional. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/meta_schema`
: Return the metadata fields of a corpus with their types and the fingerprint of the metadata schema.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/meta_values`
: Return values of the requested metadata fields.

  Body: `fields`, `corpus`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/meta_counts`
: Return document counts per value of the requested metadata fields.

  Body: `fields`, `corpus`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/docset_from_meta`
: Create a document set from metadata filters, including ranges.

  Body: `corpus`, `filters`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/docset_intersection`
: Restrict several document sets to the documents they share through their source text.

  Body: `groups`, `include_human`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/docset_from_search`
: Create a document set from the documents that contain hits of a query.

  Body: `query`, `limit`. Role: user.

### Counts and statistics

Frequency lists, n-grams, collocations, dispersion, keyness, contrast, trends, word sketches, and lexical diversity. Every result carries a method block.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/frequency_list/job`
: Start a frequency list as an analysis job.

  Body: `corpus`, `docset_id`, `stopwords`, `pos_prefix`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/frequency_diff/job`
: Start a frequency comparison of two disjoint document sets as an analysis job.

  Body: `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `min_freq`, `limit`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/frequency_list`
: Return a frequency list of word forms, lemmas, or parts of speech.

  Parameters: `stopwords`, `use_gpu`, `corpus`, `docset_id`, `group_by`, `pos`, `cql`, `offset`, `limit`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/trend`
: Return the frequency of a query per period of a metadata field such as year, per million tokens with an interval.

  Body: `query`, `cql`, `date_field`, `granularity`, `docset_id`, `corpus`, `period_values`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/ngrams`
: Return n-gram frequencies for a corpus or document set.

  Body: `min_n`, `max_n`, `limit`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/ngrams/job`
: Start an n-gram list as an analysis job.

  Body: `min_n`, `max_n`, `docset_id`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/ngrams_diff/job`
: Start an n-gram comparison of two document sets as an analysis job.

  Body: `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `min_n`, `max_n`, `limit`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/collocates`
: Return the collocates of a node with association measures and a method block.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `window`, `within_sentence`, `sort_by`, `min_freq`, `attribute`, `corpus`, `docset_id`, `offset`, `limit`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/collocation_network`
: Return a collocation network around a node (nodes and weighted edges).

  Parameters: `term`\*, `window`, `measure`, `max_nodes`, `expand_depth`, `min_count`, `within_sentence`, `attribute`, `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/collocates/kwic`
: Return the concordance lines behind one collocation row, with the window and units of the table.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `collocate`\*, `window`, `ctx`, `limit`, `offset`, `within_sentence`, `attribute`, `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/collocates/job`
: Start a collocation table as an analysis job.

  Body: `term`, `window`, `docset_id`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/collocates_diff/job`
: Start a collocation comparison of two document sets as an analysis job.

  Body: `term`, `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `window`, `within_sentence`, `sort_by`, `limit`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/contrast`
: Contrast the collocations of a node in two document sets or saved subcorpora, as an analysis job.

  Body: `term`, `target_subcorpus`, `reference_subcorpus`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/dispersion_offsets`
: Return the token positions of the hits of a query for a dispersion plot.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `corpus`, `docset_id`, `offset`, `limit`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/dispersion`
: Return dispersion measures over the documents (DP, DPnorm, range, and others) with the DP reference band.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `partitions`, `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/keyness/job`
: Start a keyness comparison as an analysis job.

  Body: `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `pos`, `corpus`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/keyness`
: Compare a target and a reference document set and return keywords with test statistics and effect sizes.

  Body: `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `pos`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/wordsketch`
: Return the collocates of a lemma grouped by dependency relation. Needs a corpus imported with dependency relations.

  Body: `term`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/wordsketch_diff`
: Compare the word sketches of two lemmas, or of one lemma in two document sets.

  Body: `term_a`, `term_b`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/lexical-diversity`
: Return TTR, STTR, Guiraud, and MATTR for a corpus or document set, or for two document sets.

  Parameters: `corpus`, `docset_id`, `target_docset_id`, `reference_docset_id`, `sttr_window`, `mattr`, `mattr_window`, `analyst_tokens_only`. Role: user.

### Analysis jobs

Status, rows, and cancellation of the jobs that the `/job` routes start.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/jobs/{job_id}`
: Return the state, progress, and summary of one analysis job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/jobs/{job_id}/cancel`
: Cancel an analysis job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/analysis/jobs/{job_id}/rows`
: Return one page of the result rows of a finished analysis job.

  Parameters: `job_id`\*, `offset`, `limit`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

### Paired corpora

Groups of variants, sentence alignment, and parallel concordance lines.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/parallel_groups`
: List the groups of variants of a paired corpus.

  Body: `corpus`, `docset_id`, `limit`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/alignment/ref_doc`
: Align the sentences of the variants of one source text, optionally around a token position.

  Body: `corpus`, `ref_doc`, `focus_pos`, `window_sentences`, `variant_margin`, `max_variants`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/kwic_parallel`
: Return the aligned passages of the other variants for one hit, with edit distance and similarity.

  Body: `pos`, `keyword`, `ctx`, `max_variants`. Role: user.

### Semantic functions

Similar words, passage search, semantic clusters, embedding packages, and the local semantic index.

`GET /api/v1/semantic/similar_words`
: Return distributional neighbours of a word that occur in the corpus, with similarity and corpus frequency. A corpus without word vectors answers 422 `word_vectors.unavailable`, a corpus whose pipeline is not installed on the server 503 `word_vectors.service_error`.

  Parameters: `term`\*, `k`, `min_score`, `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/semantic/cluster`
: Cluster the hits of a semantic search.

  Body: `ids`, `min_size`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/semantic/cluster_words`
: Cluster a list of words by the word vectors of the corpus (`corpus`, default the active corpus). A corpus without word vectors answers 422 `word_vectors.unavailable`.

  Body: `tokens`, `examples`, `corpus`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/semantic/recluster`
: Propose merges and splits of clusters. Sends cluster samples to the configured language model.

  Body: `clusters`. Role: user.

`PUT /api/v1/semantic/clusters/apply`
: Check a plan of merges, splits, and new labels and return it.

  Body: `merges`, `splits`, `renames`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/semantic/outline`
: Return a Markdown outline of clusters with up to three samples each.

  Body: `clusters`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/embeddings/local-index/preflight`
: Check whether this machine can build a local semantic index (Apple silicon, memory, disk).

  Parameters: `corpus`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/embeddings/local-index/build`
: Start or resume a local semantic index build in a separate process.

  Body: `corpus`, `levels`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/embeddings/local-index/builds/{run_id}`
: Return the state of a local semantic index build.

  Parameters: `run_id`\*. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/embeddings/local-index/builds/{run_id}/cancel`
: Cancel a local semantic index build and keep its checkpoints.

  Parameters: `run_id`\*. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/embeddings/list`
: List the packages of the embedding package catalog and whether each one is installed. The catalog of this version is empty, and no analysis reads an installed package.

  Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/settings/embeddings`
: Return the embedding backend, the values it accepts (`spacy`, `none`), the spaCy pipeline of the backend with what it embeds (`spacy_model_used_for`: `passage_queries`, the search text of a passage search, `copilot_word_clusters`, and `fallback` for corpora that record no pipeline), and for each corpus the source of the word vectors that similar words, `sim()`, passage index builds, and word clusters use (`word_vectors`) (admin role).

  Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/settings/embeddings`
: Set the embedding backend of this server process to `spacy` or `none` (admin role, not saved). Other values and a request without a backend receive 422.

  Body: `backend`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/embeddings/download`
: Download a package of the embedding package catalog in the background (admin role). Unknown packages receive 400.

  Body: `name`, `url`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/embeddings/remove`
: Remove an installed embedding package (admin role).

  Body: `name`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/analysis/embedding_search`
: Return the passages most similar to a search text. Needs a passage index.

  Body: `term`, `top_n`, `ctx`. Role: user.

### Export

Concordance files, evidence packages, and document conversion.

`GET /api/v1/download/{file_id}`
: Download a file that an export route wrote.

  Parameters: `file_id`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/export/pdf`
: Convert Markdown to PDF with pandoc and LaTeX, when both are installed on the server.

  Body: `markdown`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/export/docx`
: Convert Markdown to DOCX with pandoc, when it is installed on the server.

  Body: `markdown`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/export/concordance`
: Export all hits of a query (up to the export cap) as CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines, or XLSX with provenance.

  Body: `query`, `corpus`, `docset_id`, `sort`, `sort_dir`, `case_insensitive`, `ctx`, `format`, `excel_de`, `dialect`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/export/evidence-package`
: Return an evidence package: query, scope, index fingerprint, row hash, method blocks, and rows.

  Body: `query`, `docset_id`. Role: user. Needs a token in single-user mode.

### Line annotation

Categories and notes on concordance lines, the coding scheme, and agreement between coders.

`GET /api/v1/annotations`
: Return the line annotations of a corpus and the coding scheme of that corpus.

  Parameters: `corpus`, `docset_id`, `annotator`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/annotations/scheme/preview`
: Show which annotations a new coding scheme would change, without saving it.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Body: `categories`\*, `expected_revision`\*. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/annotations/scheme`
: Return the coding scheme of a corpus. Without corpus, the project scheme, which applies to every corpus without a scheme of its own.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Role: user.

`PUT /api/v1/annotations/scheme`
: Replace the coding scheme of a corpus (manager role). Removed categories are cleared in the annotations of that corpus.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Body: `categories`\*, `expected_revision`\*, `confirmation_token`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/annotations/multi`
: Return the annotations of every coder for each line.

  Parameters: `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/annotations/agreement`
: Return percent agreement and Cohen's or Fleiss' kappa between coders.

  Parameters: `corpus`, `docset_id`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/annotations/settings`
: Return whether several coders annotate independently.

  Role: user.

`PUT /api/v1/annotations/settings`
: Switch independent annotation by several coders on or off (manager role).

  Body: `enabled`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/annotations/import`
: Import line annotations in the export format, with a dry run option.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Body: `records`, `dry_run`, `validate_categories`. Role: user.

`PUT /api/v1/annotations/{row_id}`
: Set the category or note of one concordance line.

  Parameters: `row_id`\*, `corpus`. Body: `category_id`, `note`, `annotator`. Role: user.

`DELETE /api/v1/annotations/{row_id}`
: Delete the annotation of the caller on one concordance line.

  Parameters: `row_id`\*, `corpus`, `annotator`. Role: user.

### Projects, saved analyses, and preferences

Project records, saved analysis settings, cluster lists, and user preferences.

`POST /api/v1/projects/create`
: Create a project record (admin role).

  Body: `name`, `owner`, `quota`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/projects/{proj}/clusters`
: Return the saved clusters of a project.

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/projects/{proj}/clusters`
: Save the clusters of a project.

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Role: user.

`PUT /api/v1/projects/{proj}/clusters`
: Save the clusters of a project (same as POST).

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Role: user.

`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{proj}/clusters/rename`
: Rename one saved cluster.

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Body: `id`, `label`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/projects/{proj}/analysis-presets`
: List the saved analyses of a project.

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/projects/{proj}/analysis-presets`
: Save an analysis with its settings.

  Parameters: `proj`\*. Role: user.

`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{proj}/analysis-presets/{preset_id}`
: Change a saved analysis.

  Parameters: `proj`\*, `preset_id`\*. Body: `name`, `status`. Role: user.

`DELETE /api/v1/projects/{proj}/analysis-presets/{preset_id}`
: Delete a saved analysis.

  Parameters: `proj`\*, `preset_id`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/projects/{proj}/analysis-presets/{preset_id}/touch`
: Record that a saved analysis was opened.

  Parameters: `proj`\*, `preset_id`\*. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/prefs/update`
: Save preferences of the caller. Unknown keys are refused with 400.

  Body: `theme`, `project`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/prefs`
: Return the saved preferences of the caller.

  Parameters: `project`. Role: user.

### Copilot

Questions to the copilot and the control of a running turn. These routes need a configured language model.

`POST /api/v1/chat`
: Ask the copilot and receive the whole answer in one response.

  Body: `messages`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/chat/stream`
: Ask the copilot and receive status, tool calls, and the answer as server-sent events.

  Body: `messages`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/cancel`
: Stop a running copilot turn. No further model call or tool call starts.

  Body: `turnId`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/copilot/status`
: Return whether a language model is configured for the copilot and which model. No request goes to the model server.

  Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/copilot/lauf`
: Return the progress and result of a copilot turn that continued after its connection closed.

  Parameters: `sessionId`, `turnId`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/action/approve`
: Approve an action that the copilot proposed.

  Body: `actionId`, `sessionId`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/action/reject`
: Reject an action that the copilot proposed.

  Body: `actionId`, `sessionId`, `reason`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/clarify/answer`
: Answer a clarification question of the copilot.

  Body: `clarificationId`, `sessionId`, `answer`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/context`
: Update the interface context (corpus, scope, selection) of a copilot session.

  Body: `sessionId`, `autonomy_level`, `current_query`, `total_results`. Role: user.

`POST /api/v1/copilot/continue`
: Continue a copilot turn after an approval, a rejection, or an answer.

  Body: `sessionId`. Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/copilot/recipes`
: List the analysis recipes of the copilot with purpose, example question, and steps.

  Parameters: `corpus`. Role: user.

### Server and settings

Health, the capability contract, system information, runtime settings, and metrics.

`GET /api/v1/capabilities`
: Return the capability contract: which operations the interface and the copilot offer, with route, role, and corpus requirements.

  Role: user.

`GET /api/v1/health`
: Return `ok` and the name of the query engine.

  Open without sign-in.

`GET /api/v1/help`
: Return whether the bundled user documentation is served and its address, for the help menu.

  Open without sign-in.

`GET /api/v1/system/info`
: Return version, data locations, whether a model is configured, and size and state of the active corpus (admin role).

  Parameters: `corpus`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/settings/model-route`
: Return the model endpoint and model of the copilot and whether a key is set (admin role). The key itself is never returned.

  Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/settings/model-route`
: Change endpoint, model, and key of the copilot without a restart (admin role). The change lasts until the server stops.

  Body: `endpoint`, `modell`, `schluessel`. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/system/clear-cache`
: Clear the in-memory caches of the server (admin role).

  Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`POST /api/v1/system/rebuild-index`
: Rebuild the FAISS passage index (admin role). Without stored passage vectors the passages are embedded with the word vectors of the corpus pipeline, and a corpus without them answers 422 `word_vectors.unavailable` before a job starts. Progress arrives on a WebSocket.

  Body: `corpus`, the body is optional. Role: admin. Needs a token in single-user mode.

`GET /api/v1/metrics`
: Return server metrics in the Prometheus text format (admin role).

  Role: admin.

`GET /api/v1/operation-runs/{run_id}`
: Return the state of a long-running server operation (admin role).

  Parameters: `run_id`\*. Role: admin.

### Tool API

The analysis tools of the copilot, callable without a language model. This is a plain HTTP interface, not the Model Context Protocol.

`GET /mcp/tools`
: List the analysis tools with their parameter schemas.

  Role: user.

`POST /mcp/call`
: Run one analysis tool with arguments that are checked against its schema.

  Body: `name`\*, `arguments`. Role: user.
